definitions.explanation: The act of leaving one's home or workplace to go somewhere.

examples.japanese: {外出|がいしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please lock up when you go out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外出|がいしゅつ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
{外出|がいしゅつ}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: The department head is currently out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ので{外出|がいしゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えた→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧ほうが⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The rain is heavy, so it would be better to avoid going out.

notes:
{外出|がいしゅつ} means going out or leaving home. It is commonly used in formal and official contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {外出|がいしゅつ}する (to go out)
- {外出|がいしゅつ}{中|ちゅう} (out, away from home/office)
- {外出|がいしゅつ}{禁止|きんし} (going out prohibited)
- {外出|がいしゅつ}{先|さき} (destination when out)
- {外出|がいしゅつ}{許可|きょか} (permission to go out)

USAGE NOTE:
- More formal than {出|で}かける (to go out)
- Often used in workplace, hospital, or official contexts
- {外出|がいしゅつ}{中|ちゅう} is a common sign/status

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出|で}かける: more casual 'to go out'
- {出|で}る: general 'to go out, to leave'
